summary: Master benefits realization management to track value, strengthen governance, and report outcomes with confidence. Enroll in 5-day training.
lede: Benefits realization management connects program outputs to measurable outcomes through clear ownership, baselines, and performance measures. This course is for professionals working with projects, programs, portfolios, or transformation governance who need to plan, track, and sustain benefits. Learn to build benefits profiles and realization plans, set measurement thresholds and review checkpoints, and report progress through governance dashboards and post-implementation evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who already work with projects, programs, portfolios, or transformation governance and need to strengthen benefits realization practice. It suits you if your role involves business cases, value reporting, sponsor updates, adoption tracking, or portfolio decisions.
audience: Executive Assistants to PMO or strategy teams
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and be ready to work with templates, spreadsheets, or dashboard examples used during the exercises. Familiarity with program or portfolio reporting is helpful, and any real benefits case, business case, or performance report from your work will make the exercises more relevant.
